items.source: Returns CrudMethods meta information for the repository.

items.source: Returns the TypeInformation of the id type of the repository.

items.source:
Returns the set of types the repository shall be discoverable for when trying to look up a repository by domain
type.
items.translation: 返回当尝试通过域类型查找仓库时，该仓库应可被发现的类型集合。

items.source: Returns the raw domain class the repository is declared for.
items.translation: 返回仓库声明所针对的原始域类。

items.source: Returns the raw id class the given class is declared for.
items.translation: 返回给定类声明所对应的原始 ID 类。

items.source: Returns all methods considered to be query methods.
items.translation: 返回所有被视为查询方法的方法。

items.source: Returns the base class to be used to create the proxy backing instance.
items.translation: 返回用于创建代理后备实例的基类。

items.source: Returns the repository interface.
items.translation: 返回仓库接口。

items.source: Returns whether the configured repository interface has query methods at all.
items.translation: 返回配置的存储库接口是否包含任何查询方法。

items.source: Returns whether the given type name is a repository interface name.
items.translation: 返回给定的类型名称是否为存储库接口名称。

items.source: Returns whether the repository is a paging one.
items.translation: 返回该仓库是否为分页仓库。

items.source: Returns whether the given method is a query method.
items.translation: 返回给定的方法是否为查询方法。

items.source: Checks whether the given method is a query method candidate.
items.translation: 检查给定的方法是否为查询方法候选。

items.source: Returns whether the repository is a reactive one, i.e. if it uses reactive types in one of its methods.
items.translation: 返回该仓库是否为响应式仓库，即其方法中是否使用了响应式类型。
